items.label: Height-Adjustable Coat Rack
items.value: This coat rack features three height installation options at 39.8, 54.3, and 68.9 inches tall. Customize the rack height for toddlers, kids, or adults exactly as you need it.

items.label: Sturdy Wood Material
items.value: Crafted from high-quality, solid wood, this coat rack is sturdy and strong enough to support your clothes and items without wobbling. The large triangular base of the freestanding coat rack stand provides excellent stability.

items.label: Sufficient Storage Space
items.value: The coat rack includes 8 storage hooks to provide plenty of space to hang items including clothing, bags, hats, umbrellas, and more. The wooden coat rack can help to keep your living space tidy and organized.

items.label: Fast & Easy Assembly
items.value: Assemble the coat rack easily in a matter of minutes. Simply tighten the rack column and hooks using the threaded inserts to quickly have your coat rack put together without the need for tools. Please follow the steps and part codes in the user manual to install step by step.

items.label: Smooth & Elegant Design
items.value: Featuring polished rods and rack hooks, the coat rack won’t catch or snag on your clothing. The freestanding coat rack is designed to be a sleek and elegant addition to your office, hallway, entryway, bedroom, and more.

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Easy to assemble, no tools required.
